G1.G.Mt_pp = (if G1.G.Mu >= G1.G.MT_MIN and G1.G.Mu <= G1.G.MT_MAX then G1.G.Mu else (if G1.G.Mu > G1.G.MT_MAX then G1.G.MT_MAX else G1.G.MT_MIN));

Transformer.Bt = (if not Transformer.inService then 0 else (if time >= Transformer.TtOff and time < Transformer.TtOff+Transformer.dTtOff then 1E-06*(Transformer.Btrans*Transformer.Unom^2)/Transformer.Sbaz/Transformer.Koff/Transformer.kt^2 else 1E-06*(Transformer.Btrans*Transformer.Unom^2)/Transformer.Sbaz/Transformer.kt^2));

Line_2.RL = (if not Line_2.inService then Line_2.R_off else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff and time < Line_2.TLineOff+Line_2.dTLineOff then Line_2.Koff*Line_2.Rline*Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Unom^2 else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_2.TLineOff_1+Line_2.dTLineOff_1 then Line_2.Koff_1*Line_2.Rline*Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Unom^2 else Line_2.Rline*Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Unom^2)));

Transformer.Rt = (if not Transformer.inService then Transformer.R_off else (if time >= Transformer.TtOff and time < Transformer.TtOff+Transformer.dTtOff then Transformer.Koff*Transformer.Rtrans*Transformer.kt^2*Transformer.Sbaz/Transformer.Unom^2 else Transformer.Rtrans*Transformer.kt^2*Transformer.Sbaz/Transformer.Unom^2));

Line_1.BL1 = (if not Line_1.inService then 0 else (if time >= Line_1.TLineOff and time < Line_1.TLineOff+Line_1.dTLineOff then 1E-06*(Line_1.Bline1*Line_1.Unom^2)/Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Koff else (if time >= Line_1.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_1.TLineOff_1+Line_1.dTLineOff_1 then 1E-06*(Line_1.Bline1*Line_1.Unom^2)/Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Koff_1 else 1E-06*(Line_1.Bline1*Line_1.Unom^2)/Line_1.Sbaz)));

Line_1.RL = (if not Line_1.inService then Line_1.R_off else (if time >= Line_1.TLineOff and time < Line_1.TLineOff+Line_1.dTLineOff then Line_1.Koff*Line_1.Rline*Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Unom^2 else (if time >= Line_1.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_1.TLineOff_1+Line_1.dTLineOff_1 then Line_1.Koff_1*Line_1.Rline*Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Unom^2 else Line_1.Rline*Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Unom^2)));

Line_2.XL = (if not Line_2.inService then Line_2.R_off else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff and time < Line_2.TLineOff+Line_2.dTLineOff then Line_2.Koff*Line_2.Xline*Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Unom^2 else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_2.TLineOff_1+Line_2.dTLineOff_1 then Line_2.Koff_1*Line_2.Xline*Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Unom^2 else Line_2.Xline*Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Unom^2)));

Line_2.BL2 = (if not Line_2.inService then 0 else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff and time < Line_2.TLineOff+Line_2.dTLineOff then 1E-06*(Line_2.Bline2*Line_2.Unom^2)/Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Koff else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_2.TLineOff_1+Line_2.dTLineOff_1 then 1E-06*(Line_2.Bline2*Line_2.Unom^2)/Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Koff_1 else 1E-06*(Line_2.Bline2*Line_2.Unom^2)/Line_2.Sbaz)));

Line_1.XL = (if not Line_1.inService then Line_1.R_off else (if time >= Line_1.TLineOff and time < Line_1.TLineOff+Line_1.dTLineOff then Line_1.Koff*Line_1.Xline*Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Unom^2 else (if time >= Line_1.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_1.TLineOff_1+Line_1.dTLineOff_1 then Line_1.Koff_1*Line_1.Xline*Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Unom^2 else Line_1.Xline*Line_1.Sbaz/Line_1.Unom^2)));

Line_2.BL1 = (if not Line_2.inService then 0 else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff and time < Line_2.TLineOff+Line_2.dTLineOff then 1E-06*(Line_2.Bline1*Line_2.Unom^2)/Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Koff else (if time >= Line_2.TLineOff_1 and time < Line_2.TLineOff_1+Line_2.dTLineOff_1 then 1E-06*(Line_2.Bline1*Line_2.Unom^2)/Line_2.Sbaz/Line_2.Koff_1 else 1E-06*(Line_2.Bline1*Line_2.Unom^2)/Line_2.Sbaz)));

when abs(G1.AVR.logical_switch1.inp1inf.Signal) < G1.AVR.logical_switch1.inp2inf.Signal-G1.AVR.logical_switch1.a2 then G1.AVR.logical_switch1.T_force_on = time; end when;
